# Cncf Agentregistry Reviewer

Review agentregistry using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Application Definition &amp; Image Build category. Agentregistry is a cloud-native registry for discovering, curating, and deploying MCP servers, agents, and skills across local development and Kubernetes environments.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
